peers.name: CENTRAL MINE P N D INST L

bull_bear.body:
- "Total borrowings cut from Rs 12.4 Cr (FY25) to Rs 3.4 Cr (FY26) - a 73% reduction, improving financial health".
- Deck reports FY26 book value per share of Rs 30.6, ROCE 12.06% and ROE 15.16%.
- No dividend, buyback or stated capital-allocation policy appears anywhere in the deck.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Deck claims the company is the "World's largest Non-Emergency Integrated Grievance Management provider", entrenched in long-term government contracts that it says provide "revenue visibility and barriers to entry".
- E-Governance and Citizen Experience is described as "the core revenue engine at 89.81% of FY26 revenue" (Rs 84.11 Cr), with AI Solutions at 10.12% (Rs 9.47 Cr) and Staffing & Other Support at 0.08% (Rs 0.07 Cr).
- Customer base is concentrated and government-weighted: top 10 customers = 80% of FY26 revenue, customer retention ratio 96%, split Government 56% / Private 44%.
- Deck frames the two live verticals as "a high-margin, license-oriented software layer and our established citizen-services base"; MD states the company is "not abandoning what built this Company - two decades of enterprise trust in CRM".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Contract win] CM Helpline & Complaint Management System for Chhattisgarh state government - awarded March 2026, value Rs 19.44 Cr, project duration 4 years.
- [Contract] Biometric Face & Iris Engine for C-DAC Kolkata - supply, installation and commissioning of biometric identity verification systems, value Rs 27.95 Cr.
- [Revenue concentration] UP CM Helpline is "the company's single largest contract by billed revenue in FY26" at Rs 22.3 Cr; UP Police Helpline 112 is second-largest at Rs 21.6 Cr.
- [Earnings quality] Deck's own caveat: "FY26 net profit rose 173% to Rs 4.50 Cr, aided in part by a tax credit."
- [Named enterprise clients] Paytm (One97 Communications), Swiggy (Bundl Technologies) and LTIMindtree Limited.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions We Win Limited as a Bhopal-based GovTech and citizen-experience operator in the middle of a deliberate transformation "from a customer experience company to a technology enterprise spanning AI, Software and Global Capability Centre (GCC) services".
